keywords: Rectilinear and Angular Motions of Rigid Bodies
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn the kinematics of particles and rigid bodies under forces and moments
(2) learn the basic concepts of Newton's laws of motion
(3) learn the basic concepts of inertial forces and moments of inertia
(4) learn the plane motion of rigid bodies
(5) learn the basis of angular motion of rigid bodies and torques
(6) research the application to real structures in their localities
advice:
This is a basic course of dynamics of machines. The following subjects will be covered:
1. Rectilinear motion of a particle (horizontal motion) and the concepts of position, velocity and acceleration
2. Motion of a freely falling body (vertical motion),curvilinear motion of a particle,and motion of projectile
3. Rotational motion of a particle, tangential and normal components of acceleration, and relative motion of
   two particles
4. The basis of Newtonian Mechanics, Newton's Laws of Motion, and Equation of Motion
5. Inertia force, D’Alembert's Principle, rotational motion of a particle, and centrifugal force
6. Rotational motion of a rigid body and the moments of inertia of masses
7. Theorems of the moment of inertia; Parallel-axis Theorem, and Vertical-axis Theorem of the moment of inertia
8. Moments of inertia of common geometric shapes such as slender rod, thin rectangular plate, rectangular
   prism, thin disk, circular cylinder, and sphere
9. Rolling motion of a rigid body, combination of momentum and angular momentum, Equation of angular motion
Students will be expected to understand the meaning of technical terms and formulas.
Students will be expected to solve the exercises by themselves.
Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class because the schedules of quizzes, tests
   and reports may be changed as the class progresses.
Students should not be absent from the class as the handouts may not be received.
